author: kycrafft
body:
*NOTE*: This minigame is a pvp minigame. While there are tons of pvp minigames out there I think  this one is original. If  it somehow gets accepted and coded and put in Avicus, move it where ever you want


Basic overview: This game will have players competing for points. You will win by reaching the point limit. Kill players to earn points and players with high killstreaks to earn even more points. The higher your killstreak, the better potion effects you can get.

Goal of the game: Reach the max point limit (ex: 100-150)

Start of the game: 15-30 players will be spawned into any ol'  map on  spawn  point. They will have 10 seconds of invincibility and then bloodbath begins.

Earning points: Players earn 1 point per kill. Sound like you have to get 100 kills to win? Well thats where you are wrong. Here the bounty system comes in. As you kill more and more players, your bounty increases. When you are killed with a high bounty, the player who kills you gets your bounty in points. This creates an intense and ever changing game. Here is an example of the bounties you will get:

0 kills = 0 bounty = 1 point (when killed)
1 kill = 1 bounty = 1 point <- none extra, u just get 1 point total
2 kills = 1 bounty =1 point <- none extra, u just get 1 point in total
3 kills = 3 bounty = 3 points
4 kills = 4 bounty =  4 points
5 kills = 5 bounty = 5 points
6 kills = 6 bounty = 6 points
Ect...

As you see, your bounty realies on the number of kills you can get. Basicly after 2 kills, the number of kills you have will be rewarded in points to the person who killed you. Once you die, your bounty is reset. When you reach an increment of 5 points, your bounty will be anounced to all the players. This means that they will see you have a high bounty and try to kill you for the reward. However, you can get good potion effects every increment of 5 kills too. 


"Killstreak effects": After 5, 10, 15 and so on points, you will get potion effects to balance out everyone targeting you. Therefore you will get more kills, increasing your bounty and the reward for killing you. These are the effects:

5 kills: resistance 1
10 kills regen 1, speed 1
15 kills: resistance 1
20 kills: strength 1
25 kills: regen 1, speed 1(you will have resistance 2, speed 2, regen 2, and strength 1 by this point. But everyone in game will be targeting you)

The potion effects will stack and are infinite (you will keep the potion effects each time) until you die.

The chat will go like this:

kycraft was slain by funkystudios
funkystudios was slain by hornetjumper
<<hornetjumper has a bounty of 5>>
FightToWin was slain by G_SKIPPY
<<G_SKIPPY has a bounty of 10>>
G_SKIPPY was slain by hornetjumper
<<G_SKIPPY's bounty has reset!>>
hornetjumper was slain by FightToFight                                                                                                          ^^^^ 0_o


You will also not gain extra bounty from killing someone with a high bounty

I'm a bit confused on the bounty system still, but I think I get a general concept of it.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: So every time you kill someone, you gain 1 bounty. One someone kills you, they "collect" your bounty and gain extra points equal to your bounty.
